rows.en: The world is made complete by meeting its end...
The "Ultimate Being" I am researching is indispensable to bringing that about!!!
Now, fall!! For the sake of a better ending!!
...Ugh... That I, of all beings... It's impossiiible...!!
Three Core Medals flew out of the defeated Dinosaur Greeed!!
Core Medals...!?
Ankh snatched them out of the air in an instant!
They're purple Core Medals!!
Obtained new Core Medals. A new OOO skill has been unlocked.
...But... the heroes' rage and grief... and the energy of their hatred...
...will complete... the "Memory Memory"...

notes.note: Speakers verified against 0731.bla (MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N shows entry N+1). Labels in this slice match the script; no shift. Dinosaur Greeed (Dr. Maki) kept polite and grandiose. 'Ultimate Being' and "Memory Memory" quoted as in story_146-155.
Death line; 'sonna baka na' drawn out in the source, so the stretched 'impossiiible'.
Ankh. Three medals fall, so plural 'purple Core Medals' (the source has no number marker; the narration in #0.390 gives three).
Item-get box (OkWinIn). Wording matches earlier Core Medal pickups ('A new OOO skill has been unlocked').
Continues #0.395: the heroes' anger, grief and hatred (subject) will complete the Memory Memory. Cut at the same point as the source.
'Yarase wa shinai' = he will not let them destroy/take it. Rendered 'I will not let you have' to keep the trailing, dying cadence.

#0.399-0.428 = 15 leader-variant pairs (TextIdOffset+398+2a). Order from the second Pt_Chara_Check chain in 0731.bla (char ids 5,4,3,2,1,15,14,13,12,11,10,9,8,7,6): OOO, W (Shotaro), Momotaros, Black RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam, Zeta Gundam, Nu Gundam. Wording confirms (#0.403-404 Momotaros rough, #0.425 Zeta casual). The extractor's ?party label covers OOO.
Momotaros. Source has a typo-like 'sasete mou ze' (for 'morau ze'); read as 'I'm gonna destroy'. 'temee' rendered with 'bastard' to keep the rudeness.

Two Japanese forms of the second line: with 'omae' (OOO, W, RX, Rider 1, Mebius, Taro, Zeta) and with 'kisama' (Zero, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu). Each form gets one fixed English line; the 'kisama' one is phrased slightly harder without adding words.
Belial sneaks up behind the leader (the question mark is a taunt).
#0.431-0.445 = leader's '...!!' reaction (TextIdOffset+430+a, same 15-leader order). The 'Nu Gundam' label on #0.431 is the script's last constant name; the first slot is OOO. All identical.

#0.448-0.462 = leader's reaction (TextIdOffset+447+a, same order). Identical 'shimatta' rows share one line ('Oh no...!!'); #0.450 Momotaros 'Kuso', #0.453 Zero 'Chi', #0.458-459 00 / Wing Zero 'Nani'.
Zamsha steps in to block Belial's killing blow aimed at the leader (story_166 #0.468-0.469 confirms he takes the hit).

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0731.bla; labels match (no shift). Three leader-variant blocks (#0.399-428 pairs, #0.431-445, #0.448-462) voiced by the second Pt_Chara_Check chain: OOO, W (Shotaro), Momotaros, Black RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam, Zeta Gundam, Nu Gundam. Uncertain: #0.404 Momotaros line has a source typo, read as 'I'm gonna smash'. No new names or terms.
